page: Amazon Web Services m8gb.12xlarge is an ARM-based general purpose instance built on the Nitro Hypervisor and powered by AWS Graviton processors with ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 cores. The configuration provides 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs operating at 2.8 GHz, lacking SMT to eliminate noisy neighbor risks across thread pairings. System memory totals 192.0 GB, sustaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance carries no dedicated local instance storage and relies on networked EBS volumes, while integrating a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without discrete GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-core throughput and memory subsystem capacity. In parallel processing tasks, the instance achieved a top-tier Geekbench multi-core score of 24,004.0 and a Clang software compilation score of 69,510.0, paired with strong multi-core stress-ng performance of 81,856.98. The memory architecture exhibits top-tier throughput, sustaining uncached large-block read speeds of 435.26 GB/sec and write speeds of 217.09 GB/sec alongside a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3,338.76. Conversely, single-thread performance benchmarks such as stress-ng single-core (1,706.39) and Geekbench single-core (1,890.0) settle into average percentiles.

Data-handling and network services benefit heavily from the unified memory pipeline and 100 Gbps network interface, yielding top-tier static web serving throughput of 95.89 GB/sec, PassMark database operations of 47,924.58, and strong Redis SET performance reaching 99.04 million operations per second. CPU-based machine learning inference yields mixed results: while 70B model text generation is strong at 5.41 tokens/sec and 7B model generation reaches 38.48 tokens/sec, lighter small-model generation ranks in the lowest tier at 33.18 tokens/sec.

The hardware configuration provides high resource density and power efficiency per vCPU via dedicated ARMv9 silicon. The absence of local disk drives requires architectural reliance on network storage for persistence. The instance is suited for multi-threaded compilation pipelines, container orchestration, high-throughput caching systems, relational databases, and high-concurrency web serving tiers.
